mentions.name: AI agent post-deployment maintenance tooling
mentions.description: This project focuses on making AI agents easier to maintain after deployment, concentrating on context management, integrations, and operational reliability rather than generation.
mentions.problem: AI agents are hard to maintain after deployment; the difficult problems lie in context, integrations, and operational reliability.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lately we've been focused on making AI agents easier to maintain after deployment. The interesting problems aren't generation anymore—they're context, integrations, and operational reliability.
